verdict.rationale: Martin documents several of its own multi-item actions. Forwarding an email makes him add all the events in it to your calendar (martin-docs-23), background email triage automatically labels emails and takes follow-up actions (martin-docs-11), and to-dos can be imported in bulk from Todoist (martin-docs-25). These are narrow, scenario-specific cases rather than a general capability to operate on many arbitrary items at once. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk edit/delete across calendar, email, to-dos and notes, documented limits or scale, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk actions.
